summary: Iteration-8 testing of VozLeads landing (SEO, info-request form, admin landing config, nav/footer/privacy, mobile CTA) + regressions. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_vozlead_landing.py — 15/15 tests pass. Covers (a) POST /api/public/info-request: consent=false->400, country!=ES|CL->422, bad phone->422, valid ES/CL saved with call_status='sin_agente' when no agent, name whitespace normalized, duplicate within 24h marked 'repetida', rate limit per IP (3 ok, 4th->429); (b) GET /api/admin/info-requests requires admin (member->403), returns list w/o ip or _id and with 'id'; (c) GET/PUT /api/admin/landing admin-only, default empty, PUT with country-mismatched agent->422, correct assignment persists; (d) with ES agent configured, info-request creates a Lead doc (source='web_vozleads', max_seconds=45) and ir.call_status != 'sin_agente' (ended 'fallida' because no VAPI number, expected per request); (e) /robots.txt + /sitemap.xml served (200, valid content). Mongo cleaned between tests. Frontend Playwright verified end-to-end: (1) SEO on all 8 routes (/, /es, /cl, /telefonia-ip..., /centralita-virtual-con-ia, /central-ip..., /oficina-virtual..., /llamadas-automaticas-con-ia): data-testid marketing-page-* present, document.title has 'VozLeads' and route-specific text, meta[name=description] 161-183 chars, link[rel=canonical]=https://vozleads.com{path}, hreflang alternates=4 only on /, /es, /cl and 0 on topic pages (as spec), script#seo-jsonld parses as valid JSON containing FAQPage. hero-title and hero-eyebrow visible per route. (2) InfoForm: /es default prefix '+34', /cl default '+56'; submit without consent -> solicitar-error 'Marca la casilla…'; submit with invalid phone ('12') -> backend error surfaced in solicitar-error; valid submit -> info-form-success rendered; second form at bottom (solicitar-final-form) exists. (3) Nav: landing-nav-info-button scrolls to #solicitar (element in-view). Mobile viewport 390x844: mobile-info-cta visible. (4) Footer: footer-owner text = 'VozLeads.com by GoRoky.com'; footer-link-privacidad -> /privacidad renders privacy-page. (5) Pricing regression: /cl shows CLP, /es shows EUR/€. (6) Admin super-panel /app/admin shows landing-settings-panel with landing-agent-es-select, landing-agent-cl-select, landing-notify-email-input, landing-settings-save-button, info-requests-list — all testids present after login as admin@vozlead.es.
critical_code_review_comments: landing.py info_request: _notify is awaited on every success path (including 'fallida' and 'sin_agente'); emailer blocked/slow providers add latency to the POST response. Consider asyncio.create_task(_notify(...)) to decouple the HTTP response from mail delivery.

landing.py info_request: rate-limit is per `x-forwarded-for first entry`. If the ingress collapses many visitors behind one IP (CDN/mobile NAT), legitimate users would be rate-limited to 3/10min collectively. Consider a per-phone-prefix or per-session cookie fingerprint in addition to IP.

landing.py info_request: the Lead-dial path (`_call`) runs inline inside the POST handler, waiting on vapi + storing a Lead; a slow VAPI create_call ties up the request. Consider offloading `S.dial` as a background task and returning {ok:true, calling:true} immediately.
landing.py list_requests: no pagination, hard limit 200; superadmin UI will silently cap after 200 info_requests.
landing.py put_landing: `agent_<c>` id is validated for country but not for existence+active+same tenant (admin tenant). An inactive agent could be assigned and later fail at call time.

InfoForm.jsx: phone trim concatenates c.prefix + raw national digits without stripping accidental spaces/dashes (e.g. '612 345 678'). norm_phone on backend handles this (regex strips), but UI could pre-validate for a smoother UX.
InfoForm.jsx: error message from backend displayed via errMsg; good — however there is no field-level highlighting on invalid phone (only generic solicitar-error).
Chrome.jsx Footer: footer-link testids use `footer-link-{p.path.slice(1)}` which produces long slugs (e.g. footer-link-telefonia-ip-con-inteligencia-artificial). Works but verbose; fine for testing.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (SEO on 8 routes, form validation + success, nav/mobile/footer/privacy, admin landing panel, pricing currency regression)

test_credentials: admin@vozlead.es / VozLead2026! from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Transient member users created via /api/auth/register for 403 checks (prefix tb_land_).
seed_data_creation: Transient only. autouse fixture deletes db.info_requests before every test; module teardown resets platform_settings.landing to {empty} and deletes created agents (CL + ES). No persistent writes remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full regression suite: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v (6 files now including test_vozlead_landing.py). Pre-existing failures (unrelated to iter-8, carried over from iter-6/7): test_vozlead_iter6::test_existing_agents_migrated and test_vozlead_backend::test_recording_proxy_admin_lead. For landing tests, rate-limit is enforced per IP from x-forwarded-for; _clean_info_requests autouse fixture wipes db.info_requests so sequential tests are deterministic (pytest-xdist is enabled with LoadScope so same-module tests run in one worker). Agent voices: use 'elvira' (ES) and 'cl_catalina' (CL) when creating agents — generic names like 'sofia' are not in VOICES_BY_COUNTRY.
rca of the issue: N/A — no issues found. All 15 backend tests + 8 route SEO checks + 10 UI assertions pass. Landing feature end-to-end works: valid form submission with no agent -> 'sin_agente' (expected), with configured ES agent -> Lead created with web_vozleads source and max_seconds=45 (call may end 'fallida' when no VAPI number configured for the preview — expected per review notes). Email delivery to admin@vozlead.es is blocked by provider in preview (previously documented, not a bug).
